meetings.headline: Town Meeting let the Select Board override the commission's rulings on town buildings; the commission plans to keep pressing on the old primary school.
meetings.summary: The Architectural Preservation District Commission met remotely and approved its April minutes. Most of the meeting reviewed Town Meeting, where the Select Board gained the power to take commission rulings on town buildings to Town Meeting. An amendment giving homeowners the same right was voted down. Members then discussed the old primary school, the Brooks House and other endangered properties, and planned follow-up with the Select Board and Planning Board. The meeting adjourned.

meetings.headline: Commission agreed to oppose Article 24, a Town Meeting appeal of APDC demolition denials for town buildings.
meetings.summary: The Architectural Preservation District Commission met remotely and discussed Warrant Article 24, which would let a party aggrieved by an APDC denial of a demolition certificate for town property appeal to Town Meeting. This is widely seen as aimed at the old primary school. A member read lengthy remarks against it, members agreed on a position, and one member will write it up for Town Meeting. They also discussed a National Register nomination for the old primary school and checked whether the Ritter building is listed.
